reviewed_by: Claude Code, PR 2d of the Butler home worker design at the operator's request
reason: Harness Butler can now live in Butler's own project with a focus: the gateway's Butler capabilities read the focus project under observer reads and send changes as butler.action/v1 commands (focus taken from the chat session, surviving settings rollover); every catalog read, call and turn checks the focus project's local-only boundary against the harness profile; turns recall the focus project's memories; gateway workspace reads serve its existing folder via RuntimePlatform.focus_workspace (never created); direct nebula.work/settings/help gateway routes are refused for home sessions; reservation allows harness backends for home with tools_enabled=False (no vendor shell, files or command runtime). Selected: the four Butler home suites (new harness suite: focus lookup, local-only matrix, gateway workspace, reservation privacy and tools_enabled), Butler sessions, the harness gateway suites (work gateway, MCP catalog reads, harness chat goals, tool failure guidance, host CPU budget).
exclusions: tests/v3/test_butler_recovery.py::test_act_switches_worker_to_provider_and_queues_only_the_parent fails identically on unmodified main (same tree as #1244), so test_butler_recovery.py is not selected; its other cases passed locally with this change. No UI change; LAN validation does not apply. PostgreSQL cases skip without NEBULA_TEST_POSTGRES_URL in CI; all selected suites passed locally on SQLite and the staging postgres:16.
